```{webr}
#| include: false
#| autorun: true
# Site-wide webR session defaults. This hidden cell runs automatically on page
# load (autorun) and renders nothing (include: false). It is pulled in via an
# include shortcode on every page with interactive cells, right after the
# quarto-live _knitr.qmd include. (Do not write the include shortcode literally
# in this file - Quarto expands include shortcodes even inside code blocks,
# which makes this file include itself recursively.)
options(
  readr.show_col_types = FALSE,   # quiet read_csv() column-spec message
  dplyr.summarise.inform = FALSE  # quiet summarise() grouping message
)

# Make library() quiet: hide package startup messages ("Attaching core tidyverse
# packages", masking notices) but let real errors through untouched.
# `library` on the next line resolves to webR's shim (installed during page init),
# so auto-downloading of packages not pre-installed via _quarto.yml keeps working.
.webr_shim_library <- library
library <- function(...) {
  invisible(suppressMessages(withCallingHandlers(
    .webr_shim_library(...),
    warning = function(w) {
      # webR's shim only *warns* when a package doesn't exist in the wasm repo,
      # and the site hides warnings (cell-options warning: false) — so a typo'd
      # library() call would fail silently. Surface it as a real error instead.
      if (grepl("not found in webR binary repo", conditionMessage(w), fixed = TRUE))
        stop(conditionMessage(w), call. = FALSE)
    }
  )))
}
```
